metadata.title: Dissolution of a Partnership Firm
metadata.subject: Accountancy
learning_outcomes: Differentiate between Dissolution of Partnership and Dissolution of Firm.
Settle accounts according to Section 48 of the Indian Partnership Act.
Understand the treatment of unrecorded assets and liabilities.

blocks.content:
**Game Over!**
Everything has an end. When partners decide to completely shut down the business, sell off all assets, pay off all outside liabilities, and go their separate ways permanently, it is called the **Dissolution of a Partnership Firm**.
*Note:* This is different from 'Dissolution of Partnership' (which happens during admission/retirement where the business CONTINUES). In Dissolution of a FIRM, the business CLOSES.
blocks.content_hi:
**खेल खत्म!**
हर चीज का एक अंत होता है। जब साझेदार व्यवसाय को पूरी तरह से बंद करने, सभी संपत्तियों को बेचने, सभी बाहरी देनदारियों का भुगतान करने और स्थायी रूप से अलग होने का फैसला करते हैं, तो इसे **साझेदारी फर्म का विघटन (Dissolution)** कहा जाता है।
blocks.content_gu:
**રમત સમાપ્ત!**
દરેક વસ્તુનો અંત હોય છે. જ્યારે ભાગીદારો વ્યવસાયને સંપૂર્ણપણે બંધ કરવાનું, બધી મિલકતો વેચી દેવાનું, બહારની તમામ જવાબદારીઓ ચૂકવવાનું અને કાયમી ધોરણે અલગ થવાનું નક્કી કરે છે, ત્યારે તેને **ભાગીદારી પેઢીનું વિસર્જન (Dissolution)** કહેવામાં આવે છે.
blocks.body:
**Game Over!**
Everything has an end. When partners decide to completely shut down the business, sell off all assets, pay off all outside liabilities, and go their separate ways permanently, it is called the **Dissolution of a Partnership Firm**.
*Note:* This is different from 'Dissolution of Partnership' (which happens during admission/retirement where the business CONTINUES). In Dissolution of a FIRM, the business CLOSES.

blocks.content:
To close the books of accounts, we open a special temporary account called the **Realisation Account** (NOT Revaluation Account). 
Step 1: Transfer ALL assets (except Cash/Bank) to the Debit side of Realisation A/c.
Step 2: Transfer ALL outside liabilities to the Credit side of Realisation A/c.
Step 3: Sell the assets (Bank A/c Dr to Realisation A/c).
Step 4: Pay the liabilities (Realisation A/c Dr to Bank A/c).
blocks.content_hi: खातों की किताबों को बंद करने के लिए, हम **वसूली खाता (Realisation Account)** नामक एक विशेष अस्थायी खाता खोलते हैं (पुनर्मूल्यांकन खाता नहीं)।
blocks.content_gu: હિસાબી ચોપડા બંધ કરવા માટે, અમે **માલ-મિલકત નિકાલ ખાતું (Realisation Account)** નામનું વિશેષ અસ્થાયી ખાતું ખોલીએ છીએ (પુનઃમૂલ્યાંકન ખાતું નહીં).
